plan: possession-v2.9 (broadcast ball registered to the tactical frame through the players, then smoothed; on top of v2.5b/v2.5c)
motivation: v2.7 (features), the decoder sweep and v2.8 (Metrica-labelled training, +0.001 on the held-out Metrica match, -0.011 to -0.014 on DFL copies; possession-v28-results.json) did not help; ball information is what helped so far (no missing ball: 0.61 -> 0.70; v2.5 fill with an accurate broadcast: +0.024/+0.037).

In v2.5 the fill is used only when the broadcast ball is already accurate (median distance <= 0.50 m): with medium calibration error the gate opened on 1 of 16 copies and the gain was +0.004. Players seen by both cameras measure the calibration error directly.
seen_before_registration: One mechanical smoke test (Metrica game 1, degrade seed 5, stream seed 77, fixed quality values per regime): true broadcast ball error and gate state with and without registration; no possession score was computed. Seeds 5/77 are not evaluation seeds.

candidate.steps: clock-anchored alignment as v2.5b; per accepted broadcast frame the broadcast-minus-tactical offset at the ball from mutually nearest same-team player pairs (weights by distance to the broadcast ball, trimmed); median over +-0.5 s; subtract from the broadcast ball; +-2 frame NaN-aware mean; frames without an estimate get no broadcast ball; then the unchanged v2.5 accuracy gate (0.50 m median, 120 s, 5%) and fill
candidate.unchanged: models, features, decoders, noise gate, alignment, gate thresholds

validation.models: 4-match validation models of both paths (as v2.4/v2.5)
validation.tactical_copies: validation matches J03WN1, J03WR9, MET1, MET2; new degrade seeds 4100+10*i+j (v2.1 corruption) and 4500+10*i+j (player noise 0.3-0.6 m), j=0/1: 16 copies never used before
validation.broadcast_streams: work/synth_broadcast3.simulate_warp: the v2.5b simulator plus (a) a per-shot linear warp around the camera centre with entries sd = bias_sd/20 per metre, so the error differs between the players and the ball, and (b) a ball-only per-shot error of sd 0.25*bias_sd that players cannot reveal; regimes good/medium/bad as in v2.5 (bias_sd 0-0.2 / 0.2-0.6 / 0.6-1.5 m; ball and player noise 0.05-0.25 / 0.25-0.5 / 0.5-1.0 m); stream seed 39000+100*regime+copy; clock readings simulated as v2.5b with seed 49000+100*regime+copy
validation.systems: v2.4 (no broadcast), v2.5b (current release logic), v2.9; all on the same copy and stream
validation.score: mean official spell_f1_mean per regime over the 16 copies

select_v2_9_only_if_all: mean over the three regimes: v2.9 >= v2.5b + 0.005

if_selected: new release possession-v2.9 = v2.5c with register.py before the gate; new manifest, tests, byte-reproducibility check on an external full-size pair; run.json reports aggregate registration statistics only
limits: Simulated streams designed by the same team that designed the method; the shared-error assumption (players and ball share most of the calibration error) is built into the simulator except for the warp and the ball-only term. Real broadcast errors (height parallax of aerial balls, wrong player matches in crowds, zoom-dependent distortion) may differ; the accuracy gate, which uses ball positions the registration never used, is the run-time protection. Not a competition score.
